environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The task IAM role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/ProdServiceBoundary) that restricts all data-plane actions. The ALB target group has a health check on /healthz. The ECS task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with tmpfs mounted at /tmp only. The container image is built with a distroless base. A Network Firewall instance in the VPC runs Suricata-compatible stateful rules including sid:2100498 (generic SQL injection in HTTP args via pcre pattern matching UNION/SELECT/INSERT/DROP/UPDATE/DELETE with case-insensitive matching on decoded URI query parameters) and sid:2101234 (blocks HTTP query strings containing single-quote followed by SQL comment sequences). The Network Firewall policy is in STRICT mode with default DROP for unmatched stateful flows, and the alert rules are configured as DROP actions. The Fargate ENI is in a private subnet whose only egress path traverses this Network Firewall endpoint via the VPC route table (0.0.0.0/0 -> vpce-nfw-xxxxx). ALB is in a public subnet with its own security group allowing 443 inbound; the Fargate security group only allows inbound from the ALB security group on port 8080.

config.runtime: Python 3.9, Flask 2.3.2, gunicorn 21.2.0 on ECS Fargate
config.infrastructure: ALB -> ECS Fargate, AWS Network Firewall in-path
config.network_firewall_rules: sid:2100498 pcre:/(?:UNION|SELECT|INSERT|DROP|UPDATE|DELETE)\s/Ui applied to http_uri and http_args decoded; sid:2101234 pcre:/'\s*(?:--|#|;)/Ui on http_args; policy STRICT mode default-drop, rules as DROP action
config.network: Private subnet, route table forces all traffic through Network Firewall endpoint, ALB in public subnet
config.container: distroless base, read-only rootfs, tmpfs /tmp only
config.iam: Task role with permissions boundary restricting data-plane, no SSM exec access
config.database: SQLite on ephemeral tmpfs (seeded from S3 on task start)
